append_exact: A separate [investment income and IRCM withholding workpaper](bf-investment-income.md) now drafts selected individual-recipient and payer jobs under CGI arts. 129–156. Its [60-row writer ledger](../../evidence/ledgers/burkina-faso-capital-20261101/bf-investment-income.md) and two executable classification/distribution cases are pending independent source review. Only the corporate Guide’s two distribution-rate table rows moved to this figure home, with [immutable destinations](../../evidence/ledgers/burkina-faso-capital-20261101/old-topic-destinations.md); its IS-credit paragraph, the ten other Guide bodies and all previous evidence remain preserved. This reduces the investment-income gap without completing residence, treaty, PE, special-exemption or live-filing work. All seven domains remain partial; there is no accountant attestation.
